name: send
description: A quick airy breeze whoosh moving away
use: Message sent, item shared, comment posted
prompt: A quick soft airy whoosh of a breeze moving away, short swish, light and clean, natural, no music

name: receive
description: A soft droplet landing in a basin
use: Incoming chat message while the conversation is open
prompt: A single soft water droplet landing in a small basin, gentle and inviting, close up, natural, no music

name: notification
use: New in-app notification, reminder, badge update
prompt: A single short chirp of a small songbird, one call only, clean, close, outdoors at dawn, no background noise, no music

name: mention
use: You were mentioned or replied to, direct message
prompt: Two quick bright chirps of a small sparrow, short and clear, close, no background noise, no music

name: reaction
prompt: A single tiny water bubble popping at the surface, quick soft bloop, very short, close up, no music

name: typing
use: Typing indicator while the other person types, loops while visible
prompt: Light soft fingertip taps on a smooth wooden table in a gentle irregular rhythm, quiet and continuous, close up, no music

name: call_incoming
use: Incoming voice or video call ringtone, loops until answered
prompt: A calm steady repeating pattern of gentle water drops falling into a still pool, evenly spaced, soft and clear, natural, no music, no melody, no bells

name: call_connected
description: A soft splash of a stream starting
prompt: A short clear splash of a small stream bursting into flow over pebbles, bright and present, close up, natural, no music

name: call_end
use: Call ended, left a voice room
prompt: A single soft muted tap of a stone on wet earth, short and low, final, close up, no music

name: voice_record_start
prompt: A single air bubble rising quickly through water and popping at the surface, short soft gurgle, close up, no music

name: voice_record_stop
prompt: A short soft water drip ending with a tiny final drop, quiet and clean, close up, no music
